pricingEvidence.evidence: Web search summary: "Free: $0; Pro: $10/month ($100/year); Pro+: $39/month; Max: $100/month; Business: $19/user/month; Enterprise: $39/user/month… As of June 1, 2026, GitHub replaced premium requests with usage-based AI Credits… Base plan prices were unchanged"

sources.title: Models and pricing for GitHub Copilot - GitHub Docs
GitHub Copilot is moving to usage-based billing

nl.tagline: AI-programmeerassistent in je editor en op GitHub
nl.description: GitHub Copilot helpt ontwikkelaars met code-aanvullingen, chat in de editor en een agent-modus die taken zelfstandig uitvoert en pull requests maakt. Sinds juni 2026 rekent GitHub premium-gebruik af via AI-credits op basis van tokengebruik.
bestFor: Ontwikkelaars die in VS Code of JetBrains werken
Teams die al op GitHub samenwerken
notFor: Mensen zonder programmeerkennis die een app willen laten bouwen
limitations: Premium-gebruik via AI-credits kan de kosten laten oplopen

en.tagline: AI coding assistant in your editor and on GitHub
en.description: GitHub Copilot helps developers with code completions, in-editor chat and an agent mode that carries out tasks and opens pull requests. Since June 2026 GitHub bills premium usage through token-based AI credits.
bestFor: Developers working in VS Code or JetBrains
notFor: Non-programmers who want an app built for them
limitations: Premium usage via AI credits can raise costs
